name: ctaMediaClose
title: CTA Media Close
description: Media-backed closer with brand name, URL, and call to action. Compose for a final visual beat.

brandName.description: Brand name (rendered as a text wordmark when no logoUrl is set). Required.

logoUrl.description: Optional logo image URL. When set, renders as an in place of the wordmark.

url.description: URL shown small at the bottom. Preferred over `cta`.

cta.description: Fallback bottom text. Used only when `url` is empty.

textColor.description: Color for wordmark + bottom line. Default "#ffffff".
